note: Known `expo lint` errors already on main. CI fails if app/ or components/ reports any other finding. These were not rewritten because the fixes change selection timing, last-chance menu timing, animation, the video player, or slider gestures.

allow.reason: Copies the saved difficulty into local selection after economy storage loads. A render-time setState changes when the first paint shows the saved path.
Hides the last-chance menu when play leaves that phase, and shows it after the woods coach delay. That is session UI timing.
Animated.Value is stored with useRef().current and read while rendering the mote. The compiler rule flags that pattern, and the same line is reported more than once.
Same Animated.Value ref pattern as the mote's translate value.
The effect dependency list names the Animated.Values taken from refs during render.
The mote style passes those Animated.Values into Animated.View.
The mote style object reads the Animated.Values during render.
expo-video looping is set by assigning player.loop. The immutability rule treats the useVideoPlayer result as frozen.
The latest volume is written to a ref during render so drag handlers are not one frame stale.
The latest onChange callback is written to a ref during render so drag handlers are not one frame stale.
The latest drag-preview callback is written to a ref during render so drag handlers are not one frame stale.
PanResponder is created with a grant handler that reads those refs from gesture callbacks, not during render. The rule still flags it.
